name: Angry Orchard Innovation Cidery - Walden NY
type: Cidery / production facility (company-owned 60-acre apple orchard + Innovation Cider House; specialty/small-batch cider production)

fieldNotes.truckGate: No truck gate. The Innovation Cider House sits in the middle of a company-owned apple orchard reached by a long winding private driveway off Albany Post Road. The driveway is open with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. The orchard is ringed by agricultural deer fencing, not a security fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth — the only structure is the 15,000 sq ft timber-frame cider house with a tasting room and small-batch production. This is a hospitality/destination + R&D facility.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: At most ~1 service/loading door for ingredient and supply deliveries; no dock apron or dock bank. This is not a distribution facility. Band 0-10, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No trailer drop area and no trailer parking on the site.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Truck approach is the private driveway into the cidery; short, single-lane, no queue lane.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Wide open rural site with large parking lots and ample maneuvering room; not pinched against a busy road.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural orchard in Walden NY, set back from Albany Post Road and surrounded by orchard, farmland and woods. Cellular coverage may be moderate; flagged medium-confidence in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One main cider house building plus a couple of small ancillary farm structures; treated as a single facility -> FALSE.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural orchard at the edge of the small village of Walden, surrounded by farmland and woods -> Rural.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: No tractor-trailers on site. Most Angry Orchard production volume is at the Cincinnati brewery; Walden is a small-batch / R&D / specialty cider and visitor destination, so it does not run a freight trailer yard.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box approximates the deer-fenced orchard/cidery parcel (~60-acre planted orchard plus grounds); ~75.6 acres as boxed.

citations.claim: Establishes the Walden NY facility as Angry Orchard's (Boston Beer Co.) company-owned 60-acre orchard + Innovation Cider House at 2241 Albany Post Rd; confirms ownership/identity.
Cider house open and operating; most recent visitor reviews May 2026, no closure, current Thu-Sun hours. (corroborating only)

verification.rationale: Company-owned and operating per 2016 opening PR + current-dated tourism/review corroboration with no closure or divestiture; capped to probable because the only current-operation evidence is Tier-3 (angryorchard.com cider-house page is age-gated). FREIGHT FLAG: hospitality/R&D agritourism destination, no real trailer yard; commercial Angry Orchard production is at Cincinnati. Not a YardFlow freight target.
